newsitem.title: USA: New York Bancorp sets split, ups dividend. [CORRECTED 13:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: New York Bancorp sets split, ups dividend. [CORRECTED 13:35 GMT]

text.p: New York Bancorp Inc said Friday its board has authorized a four-for-three stock split and has increased its regular quarterly cash dividend by 33 percent.

The holding company for Home Federal Savings Bank said the new shares will be distributed and the increased dividend is payable on July 24 (corrects from July 2) to shareholders of record at the close of business on July 10 (corrects from July 1).
The company said shareholders will receive one additional share of New York Bancorp common stock for every three shares of common stock owned as of the record date.
The quarterly cash dividend of $0.15 per share will be paid on the total number of shares held after the stock split, it said.
On an annualized basis, this equates to increasing the dividend from 60 cents per share to 80 cents per share, before giving effect to the stock split, the company said.
As a result of the split, the number of common shares outstanding will increase to approximately 22 million from about 16.4 million shares outstanding at March 31, it said.
The company's last stock split (three-for-two) and dividend increase took place on Jan. 23, it said.
